description_en: A water bottle using revolve with threaded neck
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
body_r = 35       # 瓶身半径 (mm)
neck_r = 14       # 瓶颈半径 (mm)
height = 220      # 总高度 (mm)
neck_h = 30       # 瓶颈高度 (mm)
wall_t = 2        # 壁厚 (mm)
shoulder_h = 25   # 肩部过渡高度 (mm)

body_h = height - neck_h - shoulder_h

# === 外轮廓 ===
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(body_r, 0)                    # 底
    .lineTo(body_r, body_h)               # 瓶身
    .lineTo(neck_r, body_h + shoulder_h)  # 肩部斜线
    .lineTo(neck_r, height)               # 瓶颈
    .lineTo(0, height)                     # 顶
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

# === 内腔 ===
ir = body_r - wall_t
nr = neck_r - wall_t
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, wall_t)
    .lineTo(ir, wall_t)
    .lineTo(ir, body_h)
    .lineTo(nr, body_h + shoulder_h)
    .lineTo(nr, height + 1)
    .lineTo(0, height + 1)
    .close()
    .revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
)

result = outer.cut(inner)

show_object(result)
